# OpenRaft 0.10 Requirements Checklist: Unified Table Processing and Atomic Transaction Optimization

**Purpose**: Review whether the written requirements for the OpenRaft 0.9.25 → 0.10.0 upgrade are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before implementation. This is a requirements-quality review of User Story 8. It does not check that the Raft code implements the upgrade.
**Created**: 2026-11-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the OpenRaft dependency requirements explicit about the target version, the features that stay, the features that are removed, and the shims that must not remain? [Completeness, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the persisted 0.9.25 artifacts that must still decode enumerated, including log entries, vote, membership, node identity, snapshots, and application command bytes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-048, Spec §US8 scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the 0.10 storage requirements complete for truncation, streamed apply, vote reads, log streaming, and the error type? [Completeness, Spec §FR-049]
- [ ] CHK004 Are consensus-transport requirements complete for vote, append, snapshot, pre-vote, and leadership transfer, including group routing, the shared channel pool, authentication, and TLS? [Completeness, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK005 Are both the standalone single-entry write-batch requirement and the Meta-to-Data watermark requirement specified, and is multi-node append durability specified at the same level? [Completeness, Spec §FR-051, Spec §US8 scenario 2, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the cluster-view requirements complete for the existing `committed` column, the distinct local and cluster frontiers, unchanged names and order, and unknown remote progress? [Completeness, Spec §FR-052, Spec §US8 scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK007 Are leadership-transfer target checks, Pre-Vote, and the distinct not-leader, lease-expiry, and in-progress-transfer outcomes all required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-053, Spec §US8 scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK008 Are single-group `TransactionCommit`, the ban on comparing log ids or version ids across groups, and the exclusion of cross-group atomicity, XA, and sharding all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-054, Spec §US8 scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the set of optional 0.10 behaviors that need an adopt-or-decline decision enumerated in the requirements, including multi-Raft networking, pipelined append, log I/O workers, read policy, API batching, runtime stats, and metrics export? [Completeness, Spec §FR-055]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 Is the startup-failure set closed, or does "0.10 startup validation" leave additional failure conditions unnamed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-049, Spec §US8 scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "bounded" for a streamed log read quantified with a limit or with the place that limit is defined? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-049]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "cluster commit index" defined as a numeric log index, and is it distinguished from a local commit index and from a follower's last applied index? [Clarity, Spec §FR-052, Spec §US8 scenario 3]
- [X] CHK013 Are any new `system.cluster` or `system.cluster_groups` columns named and typed in the requirements, or only described by concept? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-052] Resolved: data-model §2.6 names and types them.
- [ ] CHK014 Is "unknown" remote progress defined as SQL NULL or as another representation, and is a stale healthy status after a leader change specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-052, Contract §System views]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the required outcome for leadership transfer to a non-member specified, rather than only naming that case as an edge? [Clarity, Spec §FR-053, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the Pre-Vote outcome specified for a disrupted voter while a leader still has quorum, rather than only requiring that Pre-Vote be enabled? [Clarity, Spec §FR-053, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Is what `RaftCommandBytes` display output may contain specified, including whether a length, type name, or hash is allowed? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "backwards readable" for snapshots defined against the on-disk name and metadata that remain after `snapshot_id` is removed? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK019 Is heartbeat age given a unit and a nullability rule that a reader can separate from newly appended summary columns? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-052]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK020 Do the spec, the OpenRaft contract, and the tasks use the same rule that `truncate_after` retains the named index? [Consistency, Spec §FR-049, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Required before merge]
- [ ] CHK021 Do the spec and the contract agree that `openraft-multi` is not pipelined replication and is not cross-group atomicity? [Consistency, Spec §FR-050, Spec §FR-054, Spec §US8 scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK022 Does the optional-feature list in FR-055 match the decision-log rows in the contract, with no feature required in one and omitted in the other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-055, Contract §Decision log]
- [ ] CHK023 Do the spec, the plan, and the tasks agree that a failed safety or compatibility gate stops the upgrade and forbids a partial dependency switch and disabled tests? [Consistency, Spec §FR-055, Plan §Phase I]
- [ ] CHK024 Do User Story 8's P0 priority and the P1 label on optional adoptions tell a reader which decisions block merge and which may be declined? [Consistency, Spec §US8, Spec §FR-055, tasks.md Phase 22]
- [X] CHK025 Do the task header, the plan header, and User Story 8 name the same branch and pull request for this upgrade? [Conflict, Spec §US8, Plan header, tasks.md header] Resolved: all name `feat/0.9-unified-table-transactions`, PR #412.
- [ ] CHK026 Is the contract identified as the normative requirement for items that the spec summarizes, so a conflict between them has a winner? [Consistency, Spec §US8, tasks.md Phase 18]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK027 Can SC-016 be decided from the written criteria of decoded 0.9.25 state, the log-storage suite, retained truncation index, startup refusal without deleting the last healthy copy, one standalone write batch, and no regression of single-group commit, version order, or the Meta watermark? [Measurability, Spec §SC-016]
- [ ] CHK028 Are "zero regressions" for version order and the Meta watermark tied to named existing requirements, rather than an unnamed suite? [Clarity, Spec §SC-016, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Can the Raft latency regression limit be measured: is "unaffected" defined, and are the profile, repeat count, and standalone versus cluster workloads stated in the success criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-017]
- [ ] CHK030 Do the success criteria and the contract agree on which cluster workloads are mandatory, including one busy group, the default group count, and a large idle-group case? [Consistency, Spec §SC-017, Contract §Verification workloads]
- [ ] CHK031 Is "a measurement" for adopting an optional 0.10 behavior quantified with a workload, a repeat count, a metric, and a threshold? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK032 Is "smaller or faster" for the multi-Raft network adapter given a metric and a decision threshold? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-050]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements specified for the primary path of restarting a valid 0.9.25 store and for the exception path of refusing an invalid store? [Coverage, Spec §US8 scenario 1, Spec §FR-049]
- [ ] CHK034 Are recovery requirements specified so a failed replica can rejoin without deleting the last healthy copy or recreating an inconsistent group? [Coverage, Spec §FR-049, Spec §SC-016]
- [ ] CHK035 Are requirements specified for a corrupt or missing snapshot and for logs the snapshot still needs? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK036 Are mixed 0.9 and 0.10 binaries specified as disallowed until a mixed-version RPC requirement is met? [Coverage, Spec §FR-055, Spec §Edge Cases] Resolved: coordinated restart is final, and FR-050 requires an RPC protocol version that refuses mixed peers.
- [ ] CHK037 Is coordinated restart defined as a group, a node, or the whole cluster? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-055, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK038 Are requirements specified for a follower's local frontier being reported as the cluster commit, so that case cannot satisfy the `committed` column? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-052]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK039 Are payload-disclosure limits specified for display, errors, and logs so command bytes are not written out? [Completeness, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK040 Are authentication and TLS requirements stated for every consensus RPC the upgrade changes, including pre-vote and leadership transfer? [Coverage, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK041 Are performance requirements for the upgrade recorded in seconds, with a stated regression bound that does not weaken the durability requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-017, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK042 Does a requirement keep Raft group ownership, the application store, and the application state machine as the owners, instead of an upstream example store? [Completeness, Spec §FR-051, Constitution §II]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK043 Is the version bump of the existing Raft dependency recorded as an explicit complexity exception, with optional crates excluded until an adopt decision? [Dependencies, Spec §FR-048, Spec §FR-055, Constitution §III, Plan §Complexity Tracking]
- [ ] CHK044 Is the assumption that the current toolchain already meets the 0.10 floor documented, including that a 2024-edition crate does not change the workspace edition? [Assumption, Spec §FR-048, research.md §11]
- [ ] CHK045 Are the upstream changelog, upgrade guide, and multi-Raft adapter identified as inputs, with this spec's contract remaining the requirement those inputs do not replace? [Dependencies, Spec §US8, Contract §Origin]
- [ ] CHK046 Is the requirement to capture 0.9.25 serialization fixtures before the version changes stated as a precondition, including what happens if the pin has already moved? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions, tasks.md T090]
